FIRST_CHAR_PROCESSES.doc: First-char measuring: the Claude process a reply ran on (electron/brain/claude-session.ts ClaudeTimingInfo.process).

FIRST_CHAR_REUSES.doc:
Why a Claude reply did or did not reuse the conversation's warm process (2026-11-12, docs/claude/2026-11-12-warm-reuse-fix.md); a closed
list, never text. warm: the same process as the turn before. Otherwise what ended the process the turn before: first (none in this run),
context (new conversation, character, persona, model or provider), restart (the process had died), image (the turn before carried a picture),
budget (12 turns or 60K characters), idle / hidden (unused for a while), failure (the turn before failed), other; diverged-*: the app's
history window did not line up with what Claude had been told: window (it starts outside), short (it ends before Claude's last message),
user / reply (that kind of message differs). cap (I-186): more characters were kept warm than the cap allows and hers was used longest ago.

GIVE_JOURNAL_EVENTS.doc: I-086: how one offer ended, or a picture she left you (with its closed reason).

JOURNAL_DAY_LIMIT_BYTES.doc:
A wide daily ceiling, 8 MiB (8,388,608 bytes) **with** the `truncated` marker: a line is written only while the marker still
fits after it; the line that would not leave room becomes the marker, and nothing more is written that day (earlier lines stay).

JOURNAL_RECENT.doc: "刚才发生了什么": the newest lines shown in the control window.

JournalView.doc: What the control window's "刚才发生了什么" shows (electron/memory/journal/app-journal.ts). Names come from the cards, not the journal.

MOOD_EVENT_SOURCES.doc: Where a mood change came from. The free-text reason of the event never goes further than `moodEventSource`.

MOTION_GLITCH_KINDS.doc:
动作跳变记录 (on her own model, which tests never use): when the display guard had to catch a
jump, or a physics bone kicked within one frame, which bone, how far, and what she was doing then. Numbers, a bone or morph name
of the model and closed activity names; never chat. `guard`: the R29 display guard absorbed it (degrees, or a morph weight);
`physics`: a hair or chest bone turned unexpectedly far in one frame after physics (degrees). `block` (色块哨兵, src/stage/stray-pixels.ts): her picture reached far outside where her bones are; `part` says what
the stage found (a bad bone or morph weight by name, or `gpu`: its own numbers were fine), `size` the share of the sampled
strip pixels drawn (0–1), `cleared` whether it went away after she was sent to the GPU again.

PERIOD_REVIEW_EVENTS.doc: I-088 第 1 条: one look-back (a week or a month): written, skipped (not enough to write about), failed (the call), invalid (the answer could not be used).

POSE_JOURNAL_EVENTS.doc: I-006 第 2 步: 'pause' (she did something for your breather: stretch / yawn) and 'pause-pass' (she let it go).

RPS_JOURNAL_EVENTS.doc: 'line-unread': one of her game lines was not read aloud (`unread` says why; never the line itself).

SPEECH_FAILURE_LABEL.doc: Plain words for the closed failure categories (journal lines only).

UPCOMING_JOURNAL_EVENTS.doc: P-001: she noted a plan of yours / asked about one / you spoke of it first / it expired unasked. Counts only, never the plan.

UPCOMING_JOURNAL_VIA.doc: P-001: which path noted it: the small look two quiet minutes after you said it, or the segment's note.

VOICE_CALL_VIAS.doc: I-091 (shared/voice/voice-call.ts): how a call started and why it ended.

buildJournalEntry.doc: The only way a journal line is made: field by field from closed sets. Null when anything does not fit.

describeJournalEntry.doc: "11:42 你摸了摸头 → 亲近 +6，现在：满足". Plain text only; the panel sets it as textContent.

signatures: (before: MoodValues, after: MoodValues, tr: JournalTranslate) => string
journalDeltaText.doc: The channels that moved by at least one point, biggest first, at most three: "亲近 +6、舒适 +2".

journalDuration.doc: "8 小时 12 分", "3 天 2 小时", "12 分", "40 秒": how long the app was closed, in the panel's words.

journalReason.doc: The fixed reason of an entry. Only enum fields choose it; nothing a caller wrote can reach it.

moodEventSource.doc:
The source of a mood change from the event type and the event's reason. An appraisal's reason is the model's own words and is
never looked at (its context says what kind of moment it was); any reason not in the fixed table falls back to a generic source.

readJournalLine.doc: A line read back from a journal file: parsed, then rebuilt through the same whitelist (a damaged or foreign line is dropped).
